short: A Gauss-sum bound for paired jets

lean.name: Formalism.DworkPowerSeriesWeights.thmBGauss
lean.plain: A Gauss-sum bound for paired jets
lean.note: Lean proves an upper bound for the $p$-adic norm of every coefficient of a polynomial obtained by pairing products of minors with an integral-jet series times a quadratic exponential. The bound depends on the minor sizes and the selected positions. The theorem is outside the final dependency cone.
